note: Statutory central/local division of each tax line reported in the MOF monthly 全国财政收支情况. Percentages are of the tax as collected. Stamp duty is split using the 证券交易印花税 sub-line MOF reports beside it. 'null' means the reported line bundles items on different rules with no published component split, so no ratio applies. Rules current as of 2026-09; superseded ratios (VAT 75/25 before 2016, securities stamp duty 97/3 before 2016) are not shown.

Excluding the portion remitted centrally by bank and insurance head offices.
Offshore petroleum resource tax is central; everything else is local.
Local fixed revenue since the tax began in 2018.

MOF names this line 车船税、船舶吨税、烟叶税等其他各项税收收入合计. Of the taxes it names, 车船税 and 烟叶税 are local fixed revenue and 船舶吨税 is central, and the '等' covers further small taxes MOF does not enumerate. It is predominantly local, but MOF publishes no component figures, so no ratio is assigned rather than guessed.
